`HasCustomParsing = 1` affects only attributes with a GNU spelling. It allows custom handling in `Parser::ParseGNUAttributeArgs()`.

For an attribute with a `__declspec` (`Declspec`) spelling, Clang ignores `HasCustomParsing` and parses it through `Parser::ParseMicrosoftDeclSpec` instead. `Declspec` denotes Microsoft-style `__declspec(attr)` syntax.
